title: Chamomilla recutita tea for medicinal use
intro: Chamomilla recutita tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried flowers of the chamomile plant. It is widely used in herbalism for its calming and soothing properties. This tea is often consumed to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive discomfort. It can also be applied topically to reduce inflammation and promote skin healing. In traditional medicine, Chamomilla recutita tea is valued for its mild sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
